explication: Kraken is a P2P-powered Docker registry: clients push images through a proxy and pull them from agents, which fetch blobs from peers while the tracker coordinates peer discovery. Dedicated origins seed content and bridge local files to pluggable blob backends; build-index resolves tags and supports asynchronous cross-cluster replication. The README establishes the overall component roles; sampled handlers and the source index show selected calls. Some internal wiring and unsampled subsystems are therefore represented only where documented.
